summary: Seek local-observation event frontiers instead of scanning observation history

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rebuild is introduced; opening an existing store adds an index over unchanged local observations.

schema.detail: Adds local_observations_after_store_index on local_observations(after_store_index) through the existing CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS schema initialization. Numeric schema version stays 16. Existing stores build the index once during open; ordinary reopens reuse it. Schema/index change requires Nathan's review.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or replicated digests change; local observations are local-only.

compatibility.detail: Event cursor values and client/wire contracts are unchanged. The query still returns the minimum observation ID at or after the claim frontier, including trimmed-ID gaps and no-match cases.

downtime.detail: The first store open builds the new index before API serving. On a copied store with 204768 local observations, SQLite index creation took 6.304 seconds under heavy host contention; this is not a measured daemon restart-to-API time and larger stores are unmeasured.

manual.detail: No manual migration or state reset is required; install the build and restart normally.

recovery.detail: This additive local index does not change rows or schema version. Older schema-16 binaries can read the same store; binary rollback leaves the extra index in place.
